title: reading first: why author validation refused 584 of 757 seed rows on travel_expense
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic); the maintainer set who files this epic's cards, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6951773597), from area o3-F's five-repetition ask round on #34687; the filer did not re-read the records behind it.

## Why

Three quarters of a card's sample rows being refused means its questions are asked over a different data set than the card's truth assumes, and the same cause will meet a customer's first build.

## Evidence

- Per the report: on `travel_expense`, author validation refused 584 of 757 seed rows.

## Scope

- Reading: which rule refused the rows, and whether the card's seed shape or the skill's seed guidance produced them. Post it on this card, before the next round.
- Then the fix where the cause lives: the card's seed, or the seed teaching in `skills/objectstack-data`.

## Done when

- The reading is on the card and a build of `travel_expense` seeds every row the card's truth counts.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687. A fix in `skills/**` is a governed surface.
